summary: Both sides say that every entry of the matrix minus 1 has valuation < 1 at w; π̄ is a unit at w.

steps.claim: Both reductions equal 1 iff every entry of the matrix minus 1 reduces to 0 modulo w, i.e. has w-valuation < 1.

By forall_inclHFin_sub_one_iff with P(x) = (v_w(x_w) < 1), the condition for inclHFin(k) − 1 becomes the condition for middleBaseChange(π̄)·(k − 1)·diag(conj(π̄⁻¹) at k₀); at a chosen place w the norm q_i is not N, so π̄ is a unit at w (N_split) and multiplying by π̄^{±1} does not change valuations; the two conditions agree.
steps.lean:
erw [S.forall_inclHFin_sub_one_iff fun x ↦ Valued.v (x w) < 1] <;> simp [S.chosenPlaces_q i,
    (N_split ..).resolve_right, v_inv, apply_ite, ite_apply, -Matrix.one_apply]; tauto
